verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Control Plane generates the MCP server itself from an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project, so no protocol code is needed. The CLI stages and pushes these sources for deployment, and deployed sources become connectable tools on hosted MCP servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the generation flow; custom-code support is evidenced only for TypeScript; depth of docs on how generation handles real-world specs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing

citations.quote: the Control Plane generates the server itself from a first-party source: an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project.
stage OpenAPI documents and Functions for deployment, push and monitor deployments
A source only becomes a connectable tool once deployed
